name: The Iron Cave
theme: A cave in the sandstone cliff above the Gainlands' mill lands, turned into a leg-day dungeon: squat racks bolted to the rock, a leg press carved into the wall, worn stone steps going down, chalk handprints and the echo of someone counting reps.
story: The Beefcakes who never skip leg day train in the Iron Cave. Get through their calf raises and squats to the Leg Press Throne, where the cave's champion has not stood up in years.
boss: Baron Quadzilla (the Leg Press Lord, who has not stood up in years)
buffs: Never Skip Leg Day: Beefcake units get +0/+1.
reward_repeat: Small gold and a Beefcake Pack.
hook: Old Man Mountain: "There is a cave in the cliff past the mills where they only train legs. Go see if yours hold up."
_note: Gainlands v2 (docs/art/gainlands_v2.md, Part F): a hand-made early side dungeon, open from the start (no quest). The designer's sheet has no row for it yet; when it gets one the import wins and this entry is ignored. Its own map and board (MAP-S-IRON, BB-S-IRON) drop in with import maps / import battleboards; until then it shows the Swolympus map and battleboard (MapArt.STANDIN_MAPS, Battleboards.STANDIN_BOARDS) and the House of Gains music until it has its own. Design gaps: docs/design/open_questions.md GL2-F1.

name: The Shattered Gallery
zone_text: The Capital (through the shattered mirror at Primm's castle door)
theme: Behind the cracked mirrors of Primm's castle: a gallery of silvered halls where every frame holds a 'perfect' version of someone the Wanderer beat - cold, polished and wrong. Three wings, Iron, Order and Appetite, then the mirror room.
story: After Primm falls his mirrors keep reflecting what he wanted the kingdom to be. Wren finds the glass at the castle door cracked from the inside. Beyond it, Echoes of the bosses and lieutenants you defeated fight with twisted mirror rules that stack wing by wing, and at the end waits The Perfect Copy: your own deck, your own face, a little stronger. No healing between fights; one costly place to rest.
boss: The Perfect Copy (your own deck, more HP, one extra card a turn)
buffs: Silvered (from the first wing): enemy units get +1/+0. Reflected Order (from the second wing): the first card you play each turn costs 1 more. Perfect Form (from the third wing): the first unit you play each turn is copied for the enemy.
reward_first: Big gold, essence of every Path, the feat Through the Glass and the Mirrored card finish.
reward_repeat: Small gold and a Prismatic Pack.
hook: Wren: "The mirrors in his castle are still showing a kingdom that never was. One of them cracked from the inside last night."
_note: Overnight Nov 4-5, Part 5 (docs/design/shattered_gallery.md): no new assets except one map (MAP-S-GALLERY, stand-in MAP-PC via MapArt.STANDIN_MAPS until it arrives). Echoes reuse their originals' pictures under a silver mirror shader (MirrorTint).
